title: Days until warmer temperature
statement_markdown: Given an array of integers `temperatures` represents the daily temperatures, return an array `answer` such that `answer[i]` is the number of days you have to wait after the `i`th day to get a warmer temperature. If there is no future day for which this is possible, keep `answer[i] == 0`.
explanation: Maintain a stack of indices. Iterate through the array; if the current temperature is greater than the temperature at the index on top of the stack, pop from the stack and calculate the difference in indices.
